description: This file contains the implementation of the UserRepository class, which interacts with the database to perform user-related operations such as retrieving users by username or email, and adding new users. It implements the IUserRepository interface and utilizes Entity Framework Core for data access.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: EF Core implementation of the IUserRepository interface, providing data access methods for User entities.

methods.name: UserRepository
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the repository with a database context.

methods.description: Retrieves a user by username asynchronously.

methods.description: Retrieves a user by email asynchronously.

methods.description: Adds a new user to the database asynchronously.
